D.t: John Garamendi leads by 50.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 133,500 votes; a one point swing is about 1,321 voters changing sides.

$1.2M cash against $235. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
